observations: One photo of a silver front loading washing machine standing on a tiled floor against a wall.
Photo 0 front panel reads 'LG', 'INVERTER DirectDrive 6/3kg' and a red sticker reads 'Washer+Dryer 2in1'.
The programme dial ring and the digital display are lit, so the machine at least powers on; the display digits are not clearly legible.
Door glass looks intact; clothes are inside the drum.
Front panel shows scuffs and marks, the red sticker is peeling, and the lower kick panel is dirty with dark spots.
The door seal, back, drum bearings and drain pump area are not shown.
No clip of the machine filling, washing, spinning or drying.

read_from: photo 0 front panel logo and capacity badge

claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the LG logo and 'DirectDrive 6/3kg' on the front panel.

claims.claim: Scrap, doesn't work and needs repair
claims.evidence: Photo 0 shows the panel lit so it powers on, but the fault is not shown; the seller's own admission is taken at face value and it is priced as not working.
Photo 0 shows scuffs, a peeling sticker and a dirty base, and the seller also calls it scrap.
Repair history cannot be seen from a front photo.
The seller's own words say it doesn't work and needs repair; no clip of it running.
No receipt or warranty card shown.

risks.risk: The fault is unknown and may be costly, such as a failed inverter motor, control board or drum bearings.
risks.proof: Clip of a full wash cycle start: filling, drum turning, draining and spinning, with any error code on the display.

risks.risk: Dryer function may not work even if washing does.
risks.proof: Clip of the dry only programme running with the drum turning and warm air.

risks.risk: Torn door seal, rust or leaks at the back and underside.
risks.proof: Photo of the door open showing the rubber seal all round, and photos of the back and underside.
risks.if_unproven: as needing seal and leak repair

risks.risk: Internal parts may have been removed if sold as scrap.
risks.proof: Photo of the back panel and the drain pump filter door open.

proof_requests: Clip of the machine starting a wash programme, filling, turning and spinning, showing any error code.
Photo of the rating plate on the back or inside the door rim showing the model number.
Photo with the door open showing the rubber seal and drum.
Photos of the back and underside.
Photo of the receipt or warranty card if it exists.
response.reason: The LG Inverter Direct Drive 6/3kg washer dryer is readable on the front panel, so it can be priced; the seller says it doesn't work and needs repair, which contradicts the 'works perfectly' line, so it is priced as not working until a running clip proves otherwise.
